objs.name: document
objs.description: Paperless managed document with properties, content, versions, validity, release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Corresponding document type selected when creating new documents.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number for each type included in the name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document and used in reports/workflows.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning the registered author and personal authorization.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning reviewers and personal authorization.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning releasers and personal authorization.

attributes.name: releaser_incl_translation
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning releasers including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity count starts after release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate validity extension.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which invalidated documents are archived.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose subsequent change affects e-mail notification on next released version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose subsequent change affects workflow task distribution on next released version.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version used before translation and required to be released before translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language determining visibility of released language version.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Clients in which the document is visible or not.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type documenting locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting special work steps and detailed steps relevant for few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to release cycle of main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with release of the main document and subject to versioning.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system for assigning read and change rights to documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual system user that can receive roles, permissions, tasks, notifications and distribution.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned to authorizations, distribution, or document-related roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorizations, reader assignment and distribution.

objs.name: system_role
objs.description: Role implemented in DHC VISION to provide individual users with appropriate functions.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: document_reader
objs.description: System role whose users can only view approved objects and take note of documents.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: READER.

objs.name: document_author
objs.description: System role whose users are offered in author or co-author selection lists and can create documents and change proposals.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: AUTHOR.

objs.name: document_checker
objs.description: System role whose users are offered in reviewer selection lists and can create change proposals.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: AUTHOR.

objs.name: document_approver
objs.description: System role whose users are offered in releaser selection lists and can create change proposals.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: AUTHOR.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: System role that can translate released content into another language.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: AUTHOR.

objs.name: workflow_participant
objs.description: Participant completing workflow tasks with an electronic signature.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature documented in the system for each released version.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created during editing, release, revision, invalidation or reactivation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle status of the version.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Number changed during reactivation except for original status.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing a document, created and managed without affecting document content or version history until scheduled.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: Note about an existing Change proposal that can be printed in a new document version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document to be checked before validity expires.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document for assigning user groups or persons for release information or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by distribution recipients that they have taken note of a released document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status used in acknowledgement reports.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard filled by distribution groups with document information.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report with selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter influencing evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criteria
attributes.description: Criteria filtering result lists.

objs.name: instruction
objs.description: Instruction stored in the system and evaluated in reports.

objs.name: traffic_light
objs.description: Report status indicator based on validity or workflow timing.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent version of released document content.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: Original language version state before translation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State required to be released before visibility to authorized readers.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system for which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data that documents can be linked with.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of master data linked with documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in the system by attachment of a new information object and selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Document properties and metadata are maintained.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Document content is edited.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: The document is saved.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically converted to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: The current converted document version is displayed on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned to a document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is added to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is modified.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving or archived with a main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Editing of an assigned change proposal is documented and completed.

evts.name: initiate_release_process
evts.description: The approval process is initiated for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creator workflow step.

evts.name: complete_review_task
evts.description: A reviewer completes a review task.

evts.name: complete_release_task
evts.description: A releaser completes a release task.

evts.name: reject_review_or_release
evts.description: A rejection during review or release cancels the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A document is released, automatically published, and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: notify_user
evts.description: Users are informed by e-mail about statuses, tasks, releases, change proposals, or validity processes.

evts.name: create_new_document_version
evts.description: A new document version is created for revision, scheduled change proposal, invalidation processing, or reactivation.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: A system request for validity extension is created before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: A request for validity extension is processed with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared and the document valid until date is updated.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is deleted after extension, release of a revised version, or invalidation.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: A request for AKS is created for a selected document.

evts.name: process_request_for_aks
evts.description: The request for AKS is checked, reviewed, or approved in workflow.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: The document and its attachments are declared invalid and archived.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Existing edited versions are deleted after invalidation.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Documents are physically deleted after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created and a document is selected for reactivation.

evts.name: process_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation request workflow is processed by the initiator.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document and its attachments are reactivated and a new version is created.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Distribution lists are maintained for a document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Assigned users and users of assigned user groups are informed when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipients are requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document without a signature.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Dashboards are filled with document information based on distribution groups.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: A role-specific report evaluates documents, instructions, or acknowledgements.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version is checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Visibility of a document in clients is specified.
